e2.location: nist_asd_2026/level_Ar_even_J2: row 1, 3s2.3p5.(2P*<3/2>).4p 2[5/2] J = 2, the level energy

uncertainty.provenance: nist_asd_2026/level_Ar_even_J2: the source states none (its printed precision is not one)

qualifications: The lowest even-parity levels of J = 0 and 2 (3p5 4p), reached by two photons through the symmetric part of the two-photon tensor. An even J = 1 level is reached only through its antisymmetric part, which vanishes for one common linear polarisation (DeMille et al. 1999, eqs. 1-4).

qualifications: The smallest of the lowest even-parity levels of J = 0, 1 and 2: for any polarisation the antisymmetric part of the two-photon tensor reaches J = 1. It vanishes for two photons of equal frequency.
